correctness.rationale: The exact incidence-neighborhood criterion forces the nonempty-inactive configurations and excludes all other selected incidences by minimality. With no inactive originals, exactly one selected incidence per original vertex is necessary and sufficient modulo universal incoming configurations; inclusion-exclusion counts these. Exhaustive comparison of 403,028 edge subsets in 11 cases confirms generated families and coefficients, while the proof supplies the unrestricted quantifiers. Boundary cases m=1 or n=1 and m=n=1 were verified.

Full Horton--Kilakos text was inaccessible, so residual priority risk remains.

value.rationale: The incidence subdivision of K_mn is a natural 2-parameter graph family motivating complete enumeration of all inclusion-minimal edge dominating sets. A closed labeled size-distribution polynomial, three-case structural classification, minimum multiplicity and an arbitrarily long interval of missing cardinalities near maximum are mathematically distinct from earlier scalar minimization and qualitative well-edge-domination classifications.
